seo.description: RTK Query data fetching patterns: semantic data renaming, loading states, error handling with toast notifications

header.title: Data Management via RTK Query
header.description: Detailed guide on RTK Query architecture (Code Splitting).

invariant_text: <one>createApi</one> is called only once — in <one>shared/api/backend/base.api.ts</one>. All entities inject their endpoints into this single baseApi (one cache, one tag registry). A separate createApi is allowed only for an external service with a different baseUrl.

tags.title: Global Tag Registry (Shared Layer)
tags.description: For correct operation of invalidation <one>providesTags / invalidatesTags</one>, all possible tags are collected in a centralized config.

session.title: Session Expired Action (Shared Layer)
session.description: An action declared in shared, so <one>baseApi</one> does not depend on entities. The auth slice subscribes to it via extraReducers and resets the session.

base.title: Base API Instance with Auth Guard (Shared Layer)
base.description: The only <one>createApi</one> in the project. Its base query wraps <one>fetchBaseQuery</one>: on 401 it dispatches <one>sessionExpired()</one> from shared, without importing entities.

inject.title: Endpoint Injection (Entities Layer)
inject.description: The final stage in the target entity. We import <one>baseApi</one> and call <two>injectEndpoints</two>. This code becomes the public service of the entity.
